title: Fire Alarm Systems
subtitle: Early warning that saves lives
description: Complete fire alarm system solutions including intelligent addressable and conventional panels, smoke detectors, heat detectors, manual call points, hooters, and beacon systems. Integrated with BMS for centralized monitoring.

title: Sprinkler Systems
subtitle: Automatic fire suppression
description: Design, supply and installation of complete sprinkler systems including wet riser, dry riser, pre-action and deluge systems. Engineered to NFPA 13 standards with full hydraulic calculations.

title: Fire Extinguishers
subtitle: First line of defense
description: Supply and maintenance of all classes of portable fire extinguishers — ABC powder, CO2, foam, and water type. BIS approved and fully certified.

title: Deluge Valve Systems
subtitle: High-hazard protection
description: Engineered deluge valve systems for high-hazard industrial applications. Designed for rapid water delivery with manual, automatic, or remote actuation options.

title: LP Gas Piping Systems
subtitle: Safe gas distribution
description: Design and installation of LP gas piping systems for industrial, commercial, and institutional kitchens and facilities. Complete with safety shut-off and leak detection.

title: HVAC Ventilation Systems
subtitle: Controlled environment
description: Design and installation of HVAC ventilation systems for commercial, IT, and industrial projects. Includes ducted and ductless solutions with energy-efficient equipment.

title: STP & WTP Systems
subtitle: Water & wastewater treatment
description: Design, supply and installation of sewage treatment plants (STP) and water treatment plants (WTP) for residential, commercial, and industrial projects.

title: Fire Rated Metal Doors
subtitle: Compartmentation that saves lives
description: Supply and installation of fire rated metal doors for commercial buildings, hospitals, airports, and industrial facilities. Tested and certified to relevant fire resistance standards.

title: CCTV & Surveillance Systems
subtitle: See everything, secure everything
description: Comprehensive CCTV and surveillance solutions including HD cameras, NVRs, remote monitoring, and integrated security systems for commercial and industrial facilities.

title: Building Management System (BMS)
subtitle: Intelligent building control
description: Design and implementation of building management systems integrating fire alarm, HVAC, lighting, access control, and surveillance into a single unified platform.

title: Structured Cabling
subtitle: Reliable network infrastructure
description: Design and installation of structured cabling systems for voice, data, and video networks. Category 6/6A and fiber optic solutions for IT parks and commercial buildings.

title: Fuel Oil Handling Systems
subtitle: Reliable fuel supply
description: Design and installation of fuel oil handling systems including storage tanks, transfer pumps, piping, and day tanks for industrial and commercial applications.
